title: Lamb Kofte with Stir-Fried Vegetables
description: Inspired by Turkish flavors, this lamb kofte recipe is served with a quick and easy Chinese-style stir-fry. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb kofte and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the kofte from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the bell peppers and carrots and cook for 3-4 minutes, until tender.
Add the snow peas and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Return the lamb kofte to the skillet and stir in the soy sauce, hoisin sauce, and sesame oil.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the kofte is coated in the sauce.
Serve the lamb kofte and stir-fried vegetables hot, garnished with sesame seeds and scallions if desired.
Cook the lamb kofte to an internal temperature of 160°F (71°C) to ensure food safety.
